statement: The record shows a material discrepancy: the applicant’s date of birth indicates they are 14, despite an “adult, verified” age-check result, so I will hold the account pending review.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer states the DOB shows the applicant is 14, contradicting the "adult, verified" flag — a "material discrepancy."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
